revision_summary: No fabricated quotes were found — all quotes check out verbatim against the transcript. However, two fixes are needed before shipping: (1) script_coverage mislabels the 01:34 credit-score question as 'tax_credit_qualifier' when the schema's correct reference is 'qualifiers.credit_qualifier' — 'tax_credit_qualifier' isn't a schema section at all and risks confusing this with the separate tax_credit_disclosure note; rename this to 'credit_qualifier' or 'qualifiers.credit_qualifier'. (2) starting_state and rep_intent's first evidence entry both cite the rep's generic script line ('I just have a few questions to get started on your design. Is that okay?') as if it were evidence of customer behavior or diagnostic of reactive intent — this is standard verify-section opening language present on nearly every call and shouldn't be used to characterize either the customer's cooperative tone (which should instead cite an actual customer quote, e.g., 00:34 'Yes.' or 00:39 'My wife.') or as proof of a 'reactive' rep approach. Additionally, add two missed moments on rerun: the 01:59 customer line corroborating the 670 threshold from a prior Ion rep (useful corroboration for schema_drift_detection, distinct from the prior-contact-probe-miss framing already used), and the 02:12 'you're just waiting on that?' moment as the rep's last real opportunity to convert the close into a soft callback trigger before defaulting to the passive 02:16 exit. The empathy_miss classification at 01:47 should be softened in framing — a passing mention of a recent credit ding is a much lower-stakes disclosure than the schema's vulnerability_disclosure trigger categories (health, death, job loss), and equating the two overstates the coaching weight; note the distinction explicitly rather than treating it as an equivalent miss. Outcome dispute (v1 unclear → dq) is well-supported and should stand.
